statement: There are constants θ0 > 0, C < ∞, depending only on m and the two fixed Schwartz functions, with the following properties. For 0 < |θ| < θ0, set ϵ = sign θ, y = |θ|1/m , ν = ymnf = |θ|nf , and define the norm-convergent series Kθ = X γ∈L νJϵ(∆yγ)uθ(γ). (8.12) It is self-adjoint and satisfies, uniformly for both signs, ∥Kθ∥coeff,1 ≤ C, ∥Kθ∥coeff,2 ≍ √ ν, (8.13) ∥K2 θ − Kθ∥coeff,1 ≤ Cy, ∥K2 θ − Kθ∥coeff,2 ≤ Cy √ ν. (8.14) Continuous functional calculus in C∗ r (L, θc) gives a projection pθ with ∥pθ − Kθ∥ ≤ Cy, 0 < trθ(pθ) ≤ C|θ|nf . (8.15) These fields are measurable on the intervals 0 < |θ| < θ0.
